question: Anindita Neogy Anaam has been awarded with _________
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Nritya Shiromani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anindta Neogy Anaam:-**

 
 
• **She is an US-based Kathak exponent.**
 
• Anindita Anaam is a recipient of prestigious national awards like Jayadev Rashtriya Puraskar and Bidagdha Nartaki Samman for her outstanding achievement in the preservation and promotion of Indian art in India and abroad.
 
• **She also received National Nritya Shiromani award.**
 
 
 
• **National Nritya Shiromani award:-**
 
 
• The National Nritya Shiromani award is given to outstanding dance performers and musicians of India and abroad for promoting and preserving India's traditional classical art forms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Vibhushan:-**

 
 
• **It is the second-highest civilian award in India, after the Bharat Ratna. **
 
• It is given for "exceptional and distinguished service" in any field of activity, without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• The award was instituted on 2 January 1954, and has been awarded to over 325 individuals, including nineteen posthumous and twenty-one non-citizen recipients.
 
 
 
• **Abhinandan Saroja National Award:-**
 
 
• It was started on the birthday of the legendary Guru Smt. Padma Bhushan Saroja Vaidyanathan.
 
• The award started for honoring the legacy in the field of Indian Classical Dance.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan:-**
 
 
• **It is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India, preceded by the Bharat Ratna and the Padma Vibhushan and followed by the Padma Shri. **
 
• It was Instituted on 2 January 1954, the award is given for "distinguished service of a high order... without distinction of race, occupation, position or sex."
